what: Verifier is planned before a later mutating lint-fix gate
scenario_or_breakage: _stage_and_push_ci_fixes can run run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop after _verify_failed_jobs_locally; if that lint-fix changes shared files and regresses an originally failed job, the PR is pushed without re-running that job
suggested_fix: Move or repeat failed-job verification after the relevant-checks lint-fix gate, and rerun relevant-checks if the verifier itself applies changes before push

what: New verifier omits the existing final cross-job verification pass
scenario_or_breakage: A later failed-job fix can regress an earlier job that already passed; the helper would return 0 even though it claims run_per_job_local_fix_loop-compatible rc=4 verification-regression semantics
suggested_fix: Mirror phase_a_ok_jobs/phase_a_ok_shards and rerun all locally verified jobs after all per-job fix loops, returning 4 on regression

what: ci-local-unfixable from the vendor verifier is not converted to the planned exit 3
scenario_or_breakage: run_ci_fix_vendor returning 1 with BAIL_REASON=ci-local-unfixable will fall through the outer retry loop, get cleared on the next attempt, and eventually stall as max-retries instead of surfacing the bail reason
suggested_fix: Handle vendor_rc explicitly: exit 3 when BAIL_REASON starts ci-local-unfixable, or return a distinct rc from run_ci_fix_vendor and branch on it in run_evaluate_failure
